title: ID0377128-DC/Si-D/DE[CcR62P] - Ladepunkt 1 nicht verfügbar
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charging point 1 not available, probably SECC defective. Please
carry out troubleshooting in the SCB and initiate repairs.
Charger should still be under warranty.
Root cause:
SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12 -
Possible modbus cable or faulty KF12
Solution:
Replace KF12
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
NOTE TO QM: document from RC shared directly in the Documents tab - no assessment was performed by L2 only troubleshooting steps. Suspect if there is actually a problem or not with KF12. Possible that only Ethernet cable is damaged but no report from RC

additional_info.subject: ID0377128-DC/Si-D/DE[CcR62P] - Ladepunkt 1 nicht verfügbar CRM:00315001712
additional_info.body:
Hello  colleagues,
Mr. Marcel from Stadtwerke Leipzig raised a ticket regarding a DC1 being unavailable due to Modbus error from EcoG.
From what I see in the AWS logs, this error only began happening in the 27th of August. Is there any chance that there were any tasks performed during this date?
My suggestion would be to first replace the Ethernet cable before replacing the EcoG and test for some time. Please use Mobaxterm to see if the IP is in the Network or just failing. If so please replace it and see if it's working again.
